observations.label: Dialogue and attribution in source order
observations.text:
Grand Master Shaof is beaming with pride and admiration at your progress.

"You have done impressively in your training. You have developed yourself adaquately in your understanding of the Jin. I believe you are ready for one final task."

"The Ra'Jin are led by a grand master of their own. He is secretive and remains hidden within a secret room in the center of the fortress."

"If you are up to the challenge, find others like you and come together to defeat him. Without their grandmaster, the Ra'Jin will be greatly crippled and balance may yet be restored."

observations.text:
Imperial Officer Yu
These monks are not showing any signs of resistance. I am quite sure that we could just walk past them and they would not even react. Regardless, an example must be made of them. Their defiance of the Emperor cannot go unpunished. Kill four of them, and then report back to me for the final attack.

findings.observation: Primary objective Slay 4 Shang Monks agrees in count with the Fandom-attributed Shang Monks Slain (4) variant. Description includes speaking to Imperial Officer Yu before and after the kills; these are separately retained prose steps, not proof of enforced client objectives.

Starts with and Hand in to both display Imperial Officer Yu. Previous displays Report To Officer Yu and Next displays Master Fhungusu. Neither navigation label establishes enforced prerequisites or a connection to The Ra’Jin Grand Master.

The displayed location 10195, -6661, 2185 has no chunk label in this detail field. It is retained literally, without assigning an exact NPC spawn or coordinate system. Coin reward 20 has no denomination.

Source links the emulator-hosted MMODB archive. Notes attribute a Shang Village reference to Forgotten Horde wiki in 2007-2008; dialogue is attributed to Fandom. These are cached archive transcriptions, not independently fetched corroborating sources. Offering, carrying and finishing dialogue retain source order and attribution.

Previous displays The Final Tests Of Jin; Starts with displays Shaof. No Next or Hand in to detail is present. Grandmaster Nahuji Slain and the screenshot-attributed (1) variant are separate displays. Notes describe top of the tower while offering dialogue describes a secret room in the center of the fortress. No connection to the Shang monk quest is established by these fields.

Reward tooltips were separately extracted in SHANG_MASK_COLLISIONS_ITERATION228.json. This review retains the full source reward HTML but does not infer item choice count, historical item identity, binding trigger or complete reward mechanics.
